<?php
$src = '/tmp/demo/wp-content';
$db  = glob('/wordpress/wp-content/database/.ht.*/.ht.sqlite');
if (!$db) { throw new Exception('Playground database not found'); }
copy($src . '/database/.ht.sqlite', $db[0]);
foreach (array('-wal', '-shm', '-journal') as $x) { @unlink($db[0] . $x); }
function cl_copy_dir($from, $to) {
    @mkdir($to, 0777, true);
    foreach (scandir($from) as $f) {
        if ($f === '.' || $f === '..') { continue; }
        is_dir("$from/$f") ? cl_copy_dir("$from/$f", "$to/$f") : copy("$from/$f", "$to/$f");
    }
}
cl_copy_dir($src . '/themes/chief-lending', '/wordpress/wp-content/themes/chief-lending');
cl_copy_dir($src . '/mu-plugins', '/wordpress/wp-content/mu-plugins');
if (is_dir($src . '/uploads')) { cl_copy_dir($src . '/uploads', '/wordpress/wp-content/uploads'); }
echo 'installed';

<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
global $wpdb;
$old = 'http://127.0.0.1:9400';
$new = untrailingslashit(home_url());
$cols = array(array($wpdb->posts, 'post_content'), array($wpdb->posts, 'post_excerpt'), array($wpdb->posts, 'guid'), array($wpdb->postmeta, 'meta_value'));
foreach ($cols as $c) {
    $wpdb->query($wpdb->prepare("UPDATE {$c[0]} SET {$c[1]} = REPLACE({$c[1]}, %s, %s)", $old, $new));
}
update_option('home', $new);
update_option('siteurl', $new);
flush_rewrite_rules();
echo 'urls updated';
